cues.en: Welcome to Section four Performance Metrics for Fraud Detection.

cues.en: This is Lecture 15, The Accuracy Paradox.
cues.zh: 這是第十五堂課：準確率悖論。

cues.en: So the point of this lecture is to introduce the concept of accuracy as well as why it's not a very
cues.zh: 這堂課要介紹準確率的概念，以及它為什麼不是

cues.en: good metric for fraud detection, specifically because of the large class imbalance within fraud detection.
cues.zh: 適合詐欺偵測的指標，尤其是因為詐欺偵測中的類別高度不平衡。

cues.en: So accuracy is probably the most popular metric from a specification perspective.
cues.zh: 在分類效能的評估中，準確率可能是最常見的指標。

cues.en: It's effectively the number of correct predictions, and the correct predictions would be your true
cues.zh: 它本質上反映正確預測的數量，而正確預測包括真

cues.zh: 陽性與真陰性。在高度不平衡的情況下，

cues.en: true negatives, which is your non fraudulent customers that are detected or predicted as non fraudulent, largely outweighs all of the other quadrants.
cues.zh: 真陰性，也就是實際非詐欺且被預測為非詐欺的客戶，數量通常遠遠超過其他所有象限。

cues.en: And we saw that over and over again with the logistic regression model as well as the Xgboost model.
cues.zh: 在邏輯斯迴歸與 XGBoost 模型中，我們已經一再看到這件事。

cues.en: So that quadrant significantly outweighs, you know, the magnitude or the count of the classifications in each of the other quadrants.
cues.zh: 這個象限的分類筆數，明顯大於其他每個象限。

cues.en: And that unfortunately has a negative impact on our accuracy score because it's going to influence it
cues.zh: 很可惜，這會影響準確率的判讀，因為它的影響

cues.en: So overall, it influences a lot.
cues.zh: 因此，它對整體分數的影響很大。

cues.en: And one way I can actually prove that concept is by simulating a array of zero values, right?
cues.zh: 我們可以模擬一個全部都是 0 的陣列，來證明這個概念。

cues.en: And the point of this is to basically simulate a very simple model that only predicts the negative class.
cues.zh: 目的是模擬一個非常簡單、只會預測負類的模型。

cues.en: So if a model just takes a look at any transactions, it's not actually a model.
cues.zh: 也就是不論看到什麼交易，其實甚至不能算模型，

cues.zh: 只是一段寫死規則的程式也可以。

cues.en: But if it looks at every single record and says that it's non fraudulent, the outcome of that would
cues.zh: 如果它查看每一筆紀錄，都判定為非詐欺，

cues.en: be a model effectively that has an accuracy score of 99.8%, for example.
cues.zh: 結果就可能得到例如 99.8% 準確率的模型。

cues.en: And that's because of that.
cues.zh: 原因就是

cues.zh: 類別不平衡；某種程度上，這裡的準確率其實只反映了不平衡的比例。

cues.en: So the the number of records in the majority class are so overwhelmingly influencing the accuracy score
cues.zh: 多數類別的數量，對準確率分數的影響實在太大，

cues.en: So if we've detected no fraud whatsoever, we've just said that everyone is non fraudulent.
cues.zh: 所以，即使沒有偵測到任何詐欺，只是一律把所有人判成非詐欺，

cues.en: If you look at it from an accuracy perspective, we might think that this is the best model ever, but in reality it's actually not solving the problem at all.
cues.zh: 光看準確率，可能會以為這是最好的模型，但實際上它完全沒有解決問題。
